## Purpose and Entry Points
OpenKB is a local-first Python system that compiles source documents into a persistent Markdown/OKF wiki, then uses that wiki for grounded Q&A, chat, skills, decks, and graph visualization. Primary entry points are the Click CLI in `openkb/cli.py` (package launch via `openkb/__main__.py`) and the optional FastAPI server in `openkb/api.py`. The browser workbench starts from `frontend/src/main.tsx` and is bundled for API serving.

## KB Storage and Lifecycle
A knowledge base is filesystem-backed: raw inputs, generated Markdown wiki pages, metadata/state, images, and PageIndex artifacts are coordinated rather than stored in a database. Configuration and KB administration establish layout, model settings, schema conventions, and registries.
- `openkb/kb_admin.py`
- `openkb/config.py`
- `openkb/state.py`
- `openkb/schema.py`

Mutating operations use locking and controlled file writes to preserve consistency while add/remove/recompile/watch flows alter shared wiki state.
- `openkb/mutation.py`
- `openkb/locks.py`
- `openkb/page_ops.py`

## Ingestion, Conversion, and Indexing
`add` accepts local files, directories, and URLs. URL ingestion fetches/classifies remote content; document processing converts supported formats to Markdown and extracts images. The coordinator selects short-document direct processing versus long-PDF hierarchical PageIndex processing based on configuration.
- `openkb/add_coordinator.py`
- `openkb/url_ingest.py`
- `openkb/converter.py`
- `openkb/indexer.py`

PageIndex runs locally by default; PageIndex Cloud is an optional external service enabled by `PAGEINDEX_API_KEY`, notably for OCR and large/complex PDFs. Input conversion relies on markitdown and PDF/image handling dependencies.

## LLM Compilation Pipeline
The compiler turns indexed document material into the wiki foundation: document summaries, synthesized concept pages, entity pages, cross-links, index/log updates, and schema-conforming frontmatter. It reads the existing wiki so each addition enriches prior knowledge rather than producing isolated results.
- `openkb/agent/compiler.py`
- `openkb/agent/tools.py`
- `openkb/frontmatter.py`
- `openkb/documents.py`

Agent execution uses OpenAI Agents SDK with LiteLLM as the multi-provider boundary. Models and credentials are configurable, supporting hosted providers and local-compatible runtimes; the LLM never replaces filesystem state management.

## Retrieval, Query, and Stateful Chat
One-shot queries and multi-turn chats read the compiled wiki and, when applicable, indexed long-document structure to produce grounded responses with citations. Chat sessions persist independently of the UI and expose slash-command orchestration for KB and generator actions.
- `openkb/agent/query.py`
- `openkb/agent/chat.py`
- `openkb/agent/chat_session.py`

The query/chat layer is the principal read boundary over compiled knowledge; it should not directly duplicate ingestion or wiki mutation logic.

## Generated Outputs
Two generator subsystems transform wiki knowledge into distributable artifacts. Skill Factory creates, validates, evaluates, versions, and rolls back agent-skill workspaces. Deck creation generates single-file HTML presentations and can invoke themed skills and critique/validation passes.
- `openkb/skill/creator.py`
- `openkb/skill/workspace.py`
- `openkb/deck/creator.py`
- `openkb/deck/validator.py`

Visualization renders the wiki link graph into a standalone HTML artifact, separate from the interactive workbench.
- `openkb/visualize.py`
- `openkb/templates/graph.html`

## HTTP API and Web Workbench
FastAPI routers expose KB management, documents, pages, graph data, configuration, and streaming agent output. API auth is optional bearer-token protection, appropriate to its local-first default.
- `openkb/api.py`
- `openkb/api_kbs_router.py`
- `openkb/api_documents_router.py`
- `openkb/api_pages_router.py`

The React/Vite workbench is a separate frontend client over those HTTP endpoints, with API calls centralized under `frontend/src/api/` and feature pages for KB browsing, chat, settings, and detail views.
- `frontend/src/App.tsx`
- `frontend/src/api/client.ts`
- `frontend/src/pages/KbDetail.tsx`
- `frontend/src/pages/ChatSession.tsx`
